where: limewash on night: every heading and paragraph on the page's ground
tide on night: captions, a chart's lettering, counts in an index
limewash on ink: a field, the search box, a note, a table's head
haze on ink: secondary words in a note
tide on ink: a placeholder in a field, a table's column heads, a suggestion's note
limewash on swell: a suggestion or a quiet button under the pointer
tide on swell: a suggestion's note under the pointer
night on saffron: the filled action, a chosen chip, selected text
night on deep saffron: the filled action under the pointer
saffron on night: a lit count, a guide's tag, the focus ring, a row's title under the pointer
saffron on ink: the focus ring on a field, the with-VAT figure
saffron on swell: a suggestion's label when chosen
coral on night: an error's words under a field
coral on ink: an error's mark in a note; an invalid field's edge (a mark: 3:1)
a quiet button's edge, a chip's edge on night (a mark: 3:1)
a field's edge, the search box's edge (a mark: 3:1)
the coast on the chart (a line of a picture, not a control)
